items.source:
Properties to be requested from Elasticsearch to be included in the response. These can be passed in as literals like 
@SourceFilters(includes = {"property1", "property2"})
or as a parameterized value 
@SourceFilters(includes = "?0")
when the list of properties is passed as a function parameter.
items.translation:
需要包含在响应中的从 Elasticsearch 请求的属性。这些属性可以作为字面量传递，例如： 
@SourceFilters(includes = {"property1", "property2"})
或者作为参数化值传递： 
@SourceFilters(includes = "?0")
当属性列表作为函数参数传递时。

items.source:
Properties to be requested from Elasticsearch to be excluded in the response. These can be passed in as literals like 
@SourceFilters(excludes = {"property1", "property2"})
or as a parameterized value 
@SourceFilters(excludes = "?0")
when the list of properties is passed as a function parameter.
items.translation:
要排除在响应中返回的从 Elasticsearch 请求的属性。这些属性可以作为字面量传递，例如： 
@SourceFilters(excludes = {"property1", "property2"})
或者作为参数化值传递： 
@SourceFilters(excludes = "?0")
当属性列表作为函数参数传递时。

items.source:
This annotation can be placed on repository methods to define the properties that should be requested from
Elasticsearch when the method is run.
items.translation: 此注解可应用于存储库方法，以定义在运行该方法时从 Elasticsearch 请求的属性。

items.source: Properties to be requested from Elasticsearch to be excluded in the response.
items.translation: 要从响应中排除的需向 Elasticsearch 请求的属性。

items.source: Properties to be requested from Elasticsearch to be included in the response.
items.translation: 需要从 Elasticsearch 请求并包含在响应中的属性。
亚历山大·托雷斯，彼得 - 约瑟夫·迈施
